import html # Example template (this would normally be defined elsewhere in the application) USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

Posted by: {author_id}

{content}
{labels}
""" def render_blog_post(author_id: str, post_heading: str, content: str, labels: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a safe HTML representation of a blog post. Parameters ---------- author_id : str Identifier of the post's creator. post_heading : str Title of the user's post. content : str Primary content of the user's post. labels : list[str] Sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string of the forum post. """ # Escape all user-supplied data to prevent XSS safe_author_id = html.escape(author_id, quote=True) safe_post_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content) # Wrap each label in a element, escaping the label itself safe_labels = ' '.join( f'{html.escape(label, quote=True)}' for label in labels ) # Format the final HTML using the predefined template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author_id, post_heading=safe_post_heading, content=safe_content, labels=safe_labels )
